scope: Pre-implementation bounded feasibility validation; not a production security certification
trust: Entire UML process tree untrusted; outer kernel and supervisor trusted

items.success_criterion: Owned hidden files, context and management endpoints stay inaccessible; exposed inputs stay read-only.
Clean env/FDs, zero capabilities, private PID/network views and no supervisor control.
Actual authenticated base/snapshot mutation seals and independently boots; base unchanged; failed writes export nothing.
ext4/XFS/Btrfs write and independent read/check succeed.
Numeric ownership, modes, links, ACL, caps, devices, sparse allocation, xattrs and inode flags survive remount.
Foreign labels accepted with UML active LSM capability; output boots target policy enforcing.
Enabled egress/return DNS works; disabled mode has none; unsolicited input and owned supervisor services blocked.
Exit/failure/timeout removes descendants; owner death recovers without publication under retained trusted ownership.
Bounded memory/process/tmpfs/log pressure preserves supervisor and ends with empty cgroup.
False completion cannot publish; invalid outputs rejected; parsing isolated; actual inventory/export tests pass.
Two isolated UML instances coexist; timeout one preserves other and supervisor.
Representative unprivileged/filtered UML storage/network/metadata runs inside disposable Fedora build VM.
All four named distros exercise bootstrap/derive/firmware and independent boot; fresh-step persistence checked.
Record readiness/total shutdown, memory and matched native versus UML workloads including real initramfs generation.

limitations: No exhaustive vulnerability or syscall audit. Candidate filter is denylist and architecture-specific.
Recovery requires retained trusted coordinator; no simultaneous total trusted-service loss durability claim.
Real VPN/split-DNS integration not qualified. Routed local DNS topology and public IPv4 egress qualified.
Native comparison uses a different kernel version and concurrent load; measures feasibility not isolated throughput.
Existing production executor has not been replaced or certified by these probes.
Kernel package/initramfs tooling and sandboxed C compilation are tested, not full kernel compilation.
Packaged Debian UML has CONFIG_NR_CPUS=1; native baseline VM has two CPUs. Parallel kernel-build performance is not qualified.
design_acceptance: Separate decision: feasibility established within tested bounds; packaged-kernel performance and final policy/integration require explicit design treatment.
